'''2014 European Championship Reset Beta Pär Birgander DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Pär Birgander]] at [[2014 European Championship Reset Beta]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Pär Birgander]]
* '''Event:''' [[2014 European Championship Reset Beta]]
* '''Stage:''' Results
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)|V13-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' [[Prepared Defenses]]
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2014-europeans-reset-beta-event-13th-place-ds-par-birgander-hdadtj/ PC list]
